entries.approved_english: Your SNAP application: eligibility determination complete
entries.approved_spanish: Su solicitud de SNAP: determinación de elegibilidad completada
entries.rationale: Dollar-amount-first subject reads as incentive; reframe as factual state-agency status update.

entries.approved_english: You have been determined eligible for SNAP benefits.
entries.approved_spanish: Se ha determinado que usted es elegible para recibir beneficios de SNAP.
entries.rationale: Attributes the state agency's determination to Civica. Replace with state-attributed phrasing.

entries.current_english: Almost — one more answer could speed this up
entries.approved_english: You may qualify for expedited SNAP benefits — answer one more question to check.
entries.approved_spanish: Es posible que califique para beneficios expeditados de SNAP. Responda una pregunta más para verificar.
entries.rationale: Gamification of a regulatory eligibility category. Reframe to attribute expedited criteria to 7 CFR 273.2(i).

entries.current_english: Five questions. See your monthly dollar amount before you apply.
entries.approved_english: Answer a few questions to estimate your potential SNAP eligibility. Results are estimates only — actual eligibility is determined by [Agency].
entries.approved_spanish: Responda algunas preguntas para estimar su posible elegibilidad para SNAP. Los resultados son estimaciones únicamente; la elegibilidad real es determinada por [Agencia].
entries.rationale: Pairs ease cue with incentive cue connected to applying. Reframe as a screening estimate.

Generic 'Apply for SNAP' CTA without official-link attribution; should route via the state apply portal (e.g. 'Open BenefitsCal application' for CA, 'Open MA DTA Connect application' for MA) or similar neutral path. CA-portal naming requires the same counsel sign-off MA's did.

entries.current_english: DTA needs one more thing: a recent paystub. Send a photo here or upload in the app. By {deadline} keeps your application moving.
entries.approved_english: Your SNAP application requires additional documentation. Please submit a recent paystub by {deadline}. You can reply to this message with a photo or upload it in the app.
entries.approved_spanish: Su solicitud de SNAP requiere documentación adicional. Envíe un talón de pago reciente antes del {deadline}. Puede responder a este mensaje con una foto o cargarlo en la aplicación.
entries.rationale: 'Keeps your application moving' is loss-aversion framing. Reframe as factual deadline.

entries.current_english: Tomorrow is your recert deadline ({recertDate}). 4 minutes if you start now. If you miss it, benefits pause until you submit — text RECERT for a fast link any time.
entries.approved_english: Your SNAP recertification is due {recertDate}. To recertify, visit [Portal] or text RECERT for a link.
entries.approved_spanish: Su recertificación de SNAP vence el {recertDate}. Para recertificar, visite [Portal] o escriba RECERT para recibir un enlace.
entries.rationale: Urgency + ease + loss-aversion stacked. Reframe as factual deadline with consequence stated neutrally.

entries.approved_english: SNAP recertification required — deadline in 60 days
entries.approved_spanish: Recertificación de SNAP requerida — fecha límite en 60 días
entries.rationale: Ease framing tied to recertification. Reframe to factual deadline only.

entries.approved_english: Set your EBT PIN at ebt.ca.gov
entries.approved_spanish: Establezca su PIN de EBT en ebt.ca.gov
entries.rationale: Implies Civica performs the PIN action. Reframe as 'Learn how to set your EBT card PIN' linking to official EBT/DTA instructions.
